value.stringValue: Unopened bags can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened bags can be exchanged within 14 days if the roast is not right for you. Refunds are issued 3 to 5 business days after we receive the return. Subscription orders can be cancelled anytime before they ship.

Flow.description: Returns the Nimbus Coffee return and refund policy. Use it whenever a customer asks about returns, refunds, or exchanges.
Flow.label: Get Return Policy

variables.description: The full return and refund policy text, ready to show the customer.
variables.name: policy_text

variables.description: The type of coffee product the customer asks about, for example beans, pods, or equipment. Optional. The policy is the same for every product type, so leave it blank if the customer does not say.
variables.name: product_type
